title: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Net Metering Rooftop Solar PV Grid Interactive Systems) (Fourth Amendment) Regulations, 2024

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: On Registration with Distribution Licensee, letter to concerned Circle/Division for TFR and informing applicant regarding specifications of CTPT, meter. 3 days from receipt of duly completed application

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: On Registration with Distribution Licensee, letter to concerned Circle/Division for TFR and informing applicant regarding specifications of CTPT, meter. 5 days from receipt of duly completed application

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: 2 days from receipt of TFR from field office

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: 5 days from receipt of TFR from field office

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Amended Reg 7, proviso (no feasibility study up to 10 kW)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Provided that the application for Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic systems upto 10 kW capacity, complete in all respect shall be deemed to have been accepted without requiring technical feasibility study

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: Note: Solar installation to be restricted up to T/C capacity, and if required, it is to be strengthened at the c ost of Solar Rooftop Generator.

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Amended Reg 7, second proviso (compensation for delay)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: the Licensee shall be liable to pay compensation to the consumer at a rate which shall not be less than five hundred rupees per day for each day of default.

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Substituted Reg 5.1 proviso (strengthening cost up to 6 kW)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Provided that the cost of strengthening of distribution infrastructure, including distribu tion transformer, as necessary, to facilitate the installation of Rooftop Solar PV System up to 6 KW including subsequent addition aggregating up to 6 KW, shall be included in the Annual Revenue Requirement of Distribution Licensee.

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: Provided that if augmentation of transformer/distribution network is required, the cost of such augmentation shall be borne by the consumer.

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Substituted Reg 5.1, (a) LT above 6 kW up to 100 kW
